name: Åkulla - Ästad

secondarySources.coverage: reverse direction Ästad - Åkulla on an older 17 km version, published 2019-07-11

estimatedTime.notes: Official Hallandsleden page/API had no time value. The only concrete time found is from an old pre-2024 route and should not be used as an official estimate.

difficulty.notes: Official text says the section mixes easy roads in flatter terrain with more demanding hilly terrain and forest paths, including roots near Ängens croft. Naturkartan still labels the page red/demanding; treat that as a metadata conflict because its geometry now matches the current official GPX.

routeType.notes: Official order is Åkulla to Ästad. Current official GPX/API geo_json begins at Åkulla Outdoor Resort and ends at Lägerplats Byasjön, the practical Ästad shelter endpoint. Åkulla is a multi-section junction with N6, N7, M1 and N8 nearby; Byasjön stitches to M7 Ästad - Vessigebro.

officialGpx.directionRelativeToOfficialOrder: matches official order from Åkulla toward Ästad
officialGpx.notes: Official GPX and official API geo_json match exactly. Point spacing includes one 473.3 m segment near Åkulla; inspect before turn-by-turn navigation use, but no alternative source supersedes this geometry.

officialApiGeoJson.directionRelativeToOfficialOrder: matches official GPX and official order
officialApiGeoJson.importRecommendation: equivalent to official GPX for candidate import

officialApiLineGeometry.notes: Conflicts with GPX/API geo_json and old OSM endpoint behavior. It may reflect an older route, an access tail, or a cartographic line from before the current GPX update.

naturkartan.relationToOfficialN7: Geometry endpoints and computed distance match the current official GPX/API geo_json, but metadata still differs.
naturkartan.importRecommendation: use as corroboration and facility/currentness source; do not prefer its distance/difficulty metadata over Hallandsleden.

osm.name: Hallandsleden Etappen Åkulla - Ästad

adjacentContinuity.notes: N7 stitches cleanly to N6 at Åkulla and to M7 Ästad - Vessigebro at Byasjön using official GPX. N8 Varberg - Åkulla ends nearby but not at the exact same point.

rerouteEvidence.finding: Official news says N7 was rerouted by Kalvsjön, and the Swedish text says the trail now goes west of Kalvsjön. Digital map is updated; June 2022 paper maps are stale.
rerouteEvidence.geometryEvidence: Current GPX/API diverges from old line.geometry around approximately lat 57.089-57.096, lon 12.537-12.548, with maximum separation about 532 m.

routeGeometry.geometryDecision: Use official GPX/API geo_json as canonical research geometry. Treat API line.geometry and OSM as stale/older/access-line clues. Keep endpoint label as Ästad for official naming but record practical coordinate as Byasjön shelter.

Verify exact parking coordinate and any fee/local signage before importing.

caveats: Verify current year dates and departures in Hallandstrafiken before publication/use.
Some Länsstyrelsen pages still referenced the prior 2025 Åkturen season; the Hallandstrafiken page accessed by coordinator showed 2026.

caveats: Not required for through-hiking N7.
Island access is prohibited during bird nesting 1 March-30 June; cable raft is normally in operation 1 July to mid-October.

commuteAccess.accessSummary: Åkulla is a good summer transit start via Åkturen and has parking/service at Åkulla Outdoor Resort. The practical GPX endpoint is Byasjön shelter, which does not have adjacent suitable parking and is about 1.87 km straight-line from Hållplats Ästad. Model Ästad stop, Ästad Vingård and Ästad 4H as endpoint-access/service metadata rather than as the route endpoint unless a connector is added.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort
facilities.description: Tap water refill at Åkulla Outdoor Resort.

facilities.name: Åkulla Outdoor Resort
facilities.description: Service/lodging cluster at the Åkulla start. Hallandsleden says the trail passes directly outside; operator offers lodging, cafe/restaurant, toilets/showers, warm room, food packages and water refill. Paid tent/caravan facilities should be service metadata, not free trail campsites.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Åkulla
facilities.description: Shelter/campfire site at Åkulla. Official place text says drinking water, toilet, shower, food and firewood are available at nearby Åkulla Outdoor Resort.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Yasjön
facilities.description: Island shelter reached by cable raft about 150 m out in Yasjön. Official text says the raft holds 9-12 people, island access is prohibited during bird nesting 1 March-30 June, the raft operates 1 July to mid-October, and firewood should be bought/brought from Åkulla Outdoor Resort.

facilities.name: Bexells talande stenar
facilities.description: Official on-route cultural POI with carved names and sayings on stones and rock faces.

facilities.name: Toppbjärs reservat
facilities.description: Official place text says Hallandsleden passes through Toppbjär, a reserve with old beech forest, lakeside slopes, natural viewpoints and Bexells talande stenar context.

facilities.name: Skärbäcks naturreservat / Skärbäck Nature Reserve
facilities.description: Reserve between Skärsjön, Humsjön and Grytsjön. It is listed on the N7 places feed and lies close to the GPX, but rules lane notes Länsstyrelsen may describe Hallandsleden as adjacent rather than through it; exact polygon overlay is needed before assigning crossed status.

facilities.name: Skärbäcks gård
facilities.description: Cabins near Hallandsleden with shower/WC. Fishing, walking, bathing and boat services are operator services rather than public trail facilities.

facilities.name: Öströö Fårfarm
facilities.description: Farm shop/cafe/restaurant and visitor attraction near the route. Do not infer public toilet or drinking water unless service access is separately verified.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Byasjön / Vindskydd Ästad
facilities.description: Primary practical endpoint facility at Byasjön in Långanskogen. Official place text says the shelter holds 4-5 adults and has fireplace, toilet, waste bins, recycling and a wood store a short distance away; it also warns parking directly at the shelter is unsuitable.

facilities.name: Emmas stuga i Långanskogen
facilities.description: Historic croft near the endpoint area, listed as a Hallandsleden place and on the English section page. It is about 543 m from the GPX endpoint.

facilities.name: Långanskogens naturreservat
facilities.description: Official Hallandsleden/Länsstyrelsen source says Hallandsleden goes through Långanskogen near the Ästad/Byasjön endpoint. Wet/sumpskog character is safety-relevant.
facilities.confidence: high for endpoint-area relevance; medium for exact span until polygon overlay

facilities.name: Ästad 4H-gård
facilities.description: Endpoint-area lodging/camp/service east of the current GPX end. Useful for access and services if an Ästad connector is modeled.

facilities.name: Ästad Vingård
facilities.description: Lodging/food/spa service in Ästad. It is officially listed for N7, but current GPX ends at Byasjön shelter about 1.7 km away; treat as endpoint-access service unless a connector is modeled.

facilities.name: Hållplats Ästad
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; ResRobot stop nearby at 57.063847, 12.560456
facilities.description: Endpoint-area bus stop for Ästad access. Hallandsleden place text appears to contain a copy/paste error mentioning Hållplats Åkulla.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Björkasjö
facilities.description: Official feed record but about 3.5 km from the current GPX. The place description says it lies off Hallandsleden via Björkasjöstigen.

facilities.name: Den gamla banvallen
facilities.description: Official feed record but outside current GPX bounds and closer to older linework context. Keep as a clue, not an import-ready N7 facility.

facilities.name: Skogsbo naturreservat med Hiaklitten
facilities.description: Official place text says Skogsbo is a small detour from Hallandsleden. Keep as side-trip/protected-area context unless a geometry overlay shows direct intersection.

waterSources.name: Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort
waterSources.reliability: high but verify operator opening/access close to publication
waterSources.notes: Official water point and resort text both support water refill at the start.

waterSources.name: Byasjön / Långanskogen endpoint
waterSources.notes: Byasjön shelter text lists shelter, fireplace, toilet, waste/recycling and wood store, but not drinking water. Do not import as potable water.

waterSources.name: Lakes and streams along Åkulla Bokskogar
waterSources.notes: The section passes lakes and wet Långanskogen/sumpskog areas. This is not drinking-water evidence. Fishing in Byasjön/Kalvsjön area requires a permit.

officialCampsitesAndShelters.name: Lägerplats Åkulla
caveats: Dedupe with N6/M1/N8 because Åkulla is a multi-section junction.
Fire use remains subject to dynamic fire-risk and local rules.

officialCampsitesAndShelters.name: Lägerplats Yasjön
caveats: Forbidden to enter island during bird nesting 1 March-30 June.
Cable raft normally operates 1 July to mid-October.
Firewood is not available on the island; official text says bring/buy wood from Åkulla Outdoor Resort.

officialCampsitesAndShelters.name: Lägerplats Byasjön / Vindskydd Ästad
caveats: No official potable-water point found at Byasjön.
Official place text says parking at the shelter/rest area is unsuitable and nearest general parking is Skogsbo or Skärbäck.

fireRules: Hallandsleden Important Information says to check fire rules when it is dry, use prepared fireplaces, and ensure fires are extinguished before leaving.
Länsstyrelsen reserve pages displayed forest-fire-risk banners on 2026-04-29; treat this as dated currentness evidence only.
Åkullaboket: fire only at designated places.
Långanskogen: rules lane found fire only at designated places.
Skärbäck: rules lane found no fire if the route/side trip enters that reserve; overlay before applying.
Do not store a static fire-ban/no-fire-ban claim. Runtime or later import should point users to Brandrisk Ute, Länsstyrelsen/Krisinformation, Varberg municipality or Räddningstjänsten Väst.
campingRules: Use official shelters/campsites rather than assuming free camping inside reserves.
Åkulla Bokskogar umbrella source warns that camping/tenting rules differ by reserve; check each reserve page.
Byasjön and Åkulla are official shelter/campsite records. Yasjön is seasonal/access-limited.
dogNotes: Hallandsleden dog guidance says dogs must be leashed or under very close control from 1 March to 20 August.
Reserve rules on this section generally prohibit unleashed dogs, which should be modeled as stricter local rules where applicable.
Recent adjacent AllTrails reviews describe dog-friendly walking, but that does not override livestock or reserve leash rules.

protectedAreas.name: Åkulla Bokskogar
protectedAreas.relevance: The section passes through the Åkulla Bokskogar landscape. This is not one legal reserve; rules vary by reserve.
rules: Check each reserve's own page for exact restrictions.
Umbrella page says examples of reserve restrictions can include no tents/caravans/campervans, no off-road motor vehicles, no terrain bikes or riding.
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Model as area context, not a single legal rule object.

protectedAreas.name: Åkullaboket naturreservat
protectedAreas.relevance: Start-area/Åkulla context; Länsstyrelsen says Hallandsleden goes through the reserve and directs access from Åkulla Outdoor Resort parking.
rules: Do not damage living or dead trees, bushes or branches.
Do not damage, pick or collect mosses, lichens or fungi except single edible mushroom specimens.
No caravan/campervan setup in the reserve.
Motor vehicles only on roads and parking only in designated places.
Dogs must not be unleashed.
Cycling only on marked cycle trail and existing roads.
Fire only at designated places.
Organized camps/events/competitions and certain studies require Länsstyrelsen permission.
protectedAreas.currentness: Länsstyrelsen page showed no current reserve news on 2026-04-29 but did show a forest-fire-risk banner.
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Import as start-area protected-area rule context after geometry/polygon overlay.

protectedAreas.name: Toppbjär naturreservat
protectedAreas.relevance: Official N7 narrative and Hallandsleden place text say the trail passes through/at Toppbjär and Bexells talande stenar.
rules: Dogs must not be unleashed.
Organized events/camps/competitions and some collection/marking activities require permission.
Respect motor vehicle and parking restrictions from reserve rules/signage.

protectedAreas.name: Långanskogen naturreservat
protectedAreas.relevance: Official trail and Länsstyrelsen say Hallandsleden goes through Långanskogen near Ästad/Byasjön. Terrain is wet/sumpskog and safety-relevant.
rules: Fire only at designated places.
Dogs must not be unleashed.
No riding/horses according to rules-lane summary.
No off-road motor vehicles or unauthorized parking.

protectedAreas.name: Skärbäck naturreservat

rules: No tenting according to rules-lane summary.
No fire according to rules-lane summary.
Dogs leashed.
No riding and parking only at designated places.

protectedAreas.name: Skogsbo naturreservat

rules: No tents/caravans/campervans according to rules-lane summary.
Fire only at designated place.
Dogs leashed.
Cycling/riding only on marked routes.

protectedAreas.name: Valaklitt naturreservat
protectedAreas.relevance: Official English N7 page lists it as a place of interest, but direct route crossing was not proven.
rules: Rules lane found a bird-protection access ban in part of the reserve from 1 February to 31 July.
Rules lane found full fire ban except camping stoves allowed.
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Do not attach to N7 core until geometry/polygon overlay proves relevance.

closuresAndReroutes.finding: N7 was rerouted by/west of Kalvsjön in 2024; the digital map is updated and paper maps printed June 2022 still show old routing.
closuresAndReroutes.importImpact: Use current official GPX/API geo_json. Carry stale-paper-map caveat.

terrainAndSafety: Official text: mix of easy roads, gravel/asphalt roads, nature trails, hilly terrain, and roots near Ängens croft.
Långanskogen is wet/sumpskog; expect damp ground and treat surface water.
Field reports around adjacent routes describe generally good conditions but much road/gravel and occasional livestock/electric-fence context.
No active N7-specific closure was found on official pages during the 2026-04-29 pass.
huntingAndLivestock: No N7-specific hunting closure was found.
Keep generic Halland hunting/currentness checks dynamic if later imported.
Field reports around Ästad/Öströö mention livestock/electric fences; dogs should be leashed and gates/fences respected.
fireAndEmergencyCurrentness: Do not store static fire-ban status. On 2026-04-29 Länsstyrelsen Halland pages showed forest-fire-risk messaging linking to SMHI.
Rules lane noted Räddningstjänsten Väst brand-risk guidance from 2026-04-21 and Krisinformation fire-ban page updated 2026-04-08; these should be checked at runtime/later import.

conditionReports.summary: Old reverse-direction report on a pre-2024 17 km version. Described easy walking with small roads, gravel roads and smaller forest paths; reached Åkulla in almost exactly 4 hours; noted toilet near Åkulla and intense midges after stopping to camp.
conditionReports.confidence: low for current geometry; medium for general surface character

conditionReports.summary: Very old report called Ästad-Åkulla the most beautiful first stretch, with Byasjön cultural/agricultural landscape leading into Åkulla beech forest. It described Byasjön/Ästad shelter as clean, with wood, dry toilet and bathing place.
conditionReports.confidence: low for current conditions; medium as historical corroboration for Byasjön shelter value

conditionReports.source: AllTrails adjacent Åkulla Bokskogar / Älvasjöstigen reports
conditionReports.summary: Recent adjacent-route reviews generally report good conditions, easy walking, parking, dog-friendly use, beech woods/meadows, and one 2024 note about electric fencing/livestock. Not direct proof of current N7 line.
conditionReports.confidence: medium for adjacent Ästad-area context; low-medium for exact N7 route

conditionReports.summary: Recent adjacent connector reports mention good conditions and scenic Öströö Fårfarm to Ästad Vingård area through sheep pastures, beech forest and farms.

conditionReports.source: Wikiloc Åkulla skogar Älvastigen till Björkasjöstigen
conditionReports.summary: Adjacent route starts at Ästad Vingård; describes gravel road, forest path, boardwalks and says the south side of the lake can be very wet at times.
conditionReports.confidence: medium for local wetness/access caveat; low for current N7 exact routing

conditionReports.summary: No independent post-2024 field report explicitly confirming the current west-of-Kalvsjön N7 reroute was found. Recent adjacent-route evidence is positive but indirect.

sourceContradictions.details: Official GPX/API geo_json is a 223-point 12.236 km LineString from Åkulla Outdoor Resort to Byasjön shelter. Official API line.geometry is a 382-point 13.956 km line starting 687 m away and ending about 1.124 km east of the GPX endpoint. OSM relation has 13.373 km and similar older endpoints despite a 2025 timestamp.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official GPX/API geo_json. Suppress API line.geometry and OSM as canonical route geometry. Preserve Byasjön/Ästad endpoint ambiguity for access metadata.

sourceContradictions.topic: Endpoint label Ästad versus Byasjön practical endpoint
sourceContradictions.details: Official name says Åkulla - Ästad, but the current GPX ends at Lägerplats Byasjön. Ästad Vingård, Ästad 4H and Hållplats Ästad are 1.17-1.87 km away from the GPX endpoint.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep official section name, use Byasjön shelter coordinate as current route endpoint, and model Ästad stop/services as access/connector metadata.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden page/API says 12 km and Blue/medium; official GPX computes 12.236 km and says Total: 12.3 km. Naturkartan page says 13.0 km and red/demanding while its shape computes 12.236 km. OSM says distance 13. Older reports/packages mention 15-17 km from pre-reroute or broader alignments.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official 12 km/medium with computed 12.236 km for geometry QA. Treat 13-17 km values as stale/broader.

sourceContradictions.details: Page/API classify the section under NORRA DELLEDEN, but the GPX filename is Mellersta_Akulla_Astad.gpx.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep subtrail as Norra delleden and record GPX filename mismatch as source artifact.

sourceContradictions.details: English page still says Ästad shelter was planned for spring 2020; official place data and Swedish/current sources confirm the Byasjön/Ästad shelter exists and was built in 2020.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use Swedish page/API/place records for shelter status; flag English copy as stale.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden place record is named Hållplats Ästad but appears to describe Hållplats Åkulla being served by Åkturen.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use stop name/coordinates from ResRobot and Hallandsleden coordinate, but do not reuse the place description verbatim.

mainThreadChecks: Fetched official section page, extracted public Hoodin token, and verified official GPX/API geo_json statistics.
Fetched Hallandsleden places API and computed facility proximity against official GPX.
Compared official GPX/API geo_json with API line.geometry, Naturkartan API/site data and OSM relation 7398315.
Checked ResRobot stop coordinates for Åkulla, Ästad, Hakestad, Öströö, Skärbäck and Högryd.
Reviewed Hallandstrafiken Åkturen and Beställningstrafik pages.
Reviewed official reroute page and Länsstyrelsen Åkullaboket, Åkulla Bokskogar, Toppbjär, Långanskogen, Skärbäck, Skogsbo and Valaklitt rule context.
researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Strong enough for research-ready section file with explicit caveats. No second agent batch needed because all six lanes and the main-thread pass agree on canonical GPX/API geo_json geometry, the endpoint/access ambiguity is well characterized, core facilities have official coordinates, and remaining issues are import-time overlay/currentness/connector decisions.

openQuestions: Before normalization, decide whether the app endpoint display should remain simply Ästad or become Ästad / Byasjön shelter while preserving the official section name.
Before navigation-grade use, inspect the 473.3 m GPX segment near Åkulla to ensure the point spacing is intentional simplification rather than missing line detail.
Ask Hallandsleden/Varberg why API line.geometry and GPX/API geo_json coexist with different N7 endpoints; until resolved, suppress line.geometry for canonical import.
Run protected-area polygon overlay for Åkullaboket, Toppbjär, Långanskogen, Skärbäck, Skogsbo and Valaklitt before attaching span-level rules.
Verify current Hallandstrafiken line 660/Åkturen service and any demand-responsive requirements close to publication/use.
Verify exact Åkulla parking coordinates and any fee/local signage before importing parking metadata.
Verify whether Ästad 4H, Ästad Vingård and Hållplats Ästad should be represented through an explicit endpoint connector from Byasjön.
Do not import Byasjön as a potable water source unless a separate drinking-water source is confirmed.
Do not use old 15-17 km reports, OSM relation geometry or API line.geometry as current geometry.

importReadiness.geometry: ready: official GPX/API geo_json is the canonical N7 geometry, Naturkartan geometry corroborates it, and OSM/API line.geometry should be suppressed as stale/older/access-line evidence
importReadiness.commuteAccess: ready with caveats: Åkulla stop is close to the start and seasonal; Ästad stop is useful but about 1.87 km from the Byasjön GPX endpoint, so endpoint-access metadata or a connector is needed
importReadiness.facilities: core facilities are ready with dedupe and side-service decisions: Åkulla water/resort/shelters, Yasjön seasonal shelter, Bexells talande stenar, Toppbjär, Skärbäcks gård, Öströö Fårfarm and Byasjön shelter. Ästad services and off-route records need connector/side-service modeling.
importReadiness.rulesAndSafety: ready with runtime fire-ban checks, reserve-specific rules, dog leash notes, Yasjön seasonal closure, wet Långanskogen context and 2024 Kalvsjön reroute caveat; protected-area polygon overlay remains needed before span-level import
doNotImportYet: Do not integrate into runtime app data until a later import phase.
Do not use Hallandsleden API line.geometry or OSM relation 7398315 as canonical current N7 geometry.
Do not treat Hållplats Ästad or Ästad Vingård as being at the current GPX endpoint; model access/connector metadata.
Do not import Byasjön lake/shelter as potable drinking water.
Do not freeze fire-risk, closure, hunting, transit or seasonal raft status.
Do not model Yasjön island shelter as always accessible.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Phase 2 with N8 hallandsleden-varberg-akulla using the same six-lane workflow, paying attention to Varberg urban start access, Åkulla junction dedupe, coastal/urban service density, and possible N8/N7/M1/N6 endpoint offset at Åkulla.
